newsitem.title: USA: International Fibercom sees Q1 profit, record revs.
newsitem.headline: International Fibercom sees Q1 profit, record revs.

text.p: International Fibercom Inc said on Wednesday it expects to report record revenues and a profit for the first quarter ended March 31.

The company said its 1996 results were hurt by the loss of a major contract and an unexpected cost overrun on an installation contract. It said that since then, it has had a "strong recovery" reflecting cost cutting, improved operating efficiences and contract expansion.
The company said it expects its full year 1997 revenues to exceed $32 million.
